title: Membership and even occurrence
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type with decidable equality, let $x\in\alpha$, and let $\mathcal S$ be a finite list of finite subsets of $\alpha$. Then $x$ is absent from the symmetric difference of the sets in $\mathcal S$ if and only if the number of sets in the list that contain $x$ is even.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal S$ is a finite list of finite subsets of $\alpha$
